title.zh: 将八打雁省 八打雁市镇 Libjo村 Malitam小村改设为村的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Malitam, in the Barrio of Libjo, Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, into a Barrio
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Malitam, in the Barrio of Libjo, Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, into a Barrio
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Malitam tại Barrio Libjo, Đô thị Batangas, Tỉnh Batangas thành Barrio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Malitam ในบารังไกย์ Libjo เทศบาล Batangas จังหวัด Batangas เป็น บาริโอ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Malitam di Barrio Libjo, Kotamadya Batangas, Provinsi Batangas menjadi Barrio
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Malitam di Barrio Libjo, Perbandaran Batangas, Wilayah Batangas kepada Barrio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1141_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Malitam, in the barrio of Libjo, municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, is converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio of Malitam.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1954.
